faq.title: Questions Wey People Dey Ask
faq.a1: Oxford Financial Ads na AI-powered arbitrage trading platform wey dey use Arbitrum network to make profit from price differences across many exchanges with minimal risk.
faq.q2: Wetin be OFA token and how I go get am?
faq.a2: OFA na the main token for our platform. When you finish pre-registration, you go receive 100 free tokens, and you fit earn extra bonus tokens for every referral wey succeed.
faq.q3: Why my OFA tokens dey locked?
faq.a3: The tokens dey locked for now make price stay stable. According to our roadmap, dem go gradually unlock am and we go fit withdraw after exchange listings.
faq.q4: I fit withdraw my daily trading profits (USDT)?
faq.a4: Yes o. You fit withdraw the daily ROI from your investment package anytime direct to your personal wallet.
faq.a5: We dey use Arbitrum Layer-2 network wey very secure. Our AI bot no dey trade by guessing, e dey use mathematical data to execute trades, so your money safe.
faq.q6: How the referral commission system take work?
faq.a6: We get powerful 5-level referral system. When person join through your referral link, you go earn daily commissions plus bonus OFA tokens.
faq.supportText: Our support team dey available 24/7 to help you with anything concerning Oxford Financial Ads.

mining.step2: 2. OFA tokens dey mine continuously at rate wey match daily cap divide by 86,400 seconds.
mining.step3: 3. After at least 1 minute, you fit click "Claim Reward" to transfer mined tokens to your Mining Wallet.
